agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on June 25, 2025 in Built Heritage Committee Report 23.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on June 9, 2025, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on June 10, 2025.

sub_agendas_items.title: Designation of 119 Osgoode Street under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

attachments.attachment_title: Report - ACS2025-PDB-RHU-0031 - Designation of 119 Osgoode Street.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Vice Chair Plante introduced BHC motion No. 2025-23-01. Avery Marshall, Planner I, delivered a slide deck presentation providing an overview of the recommendations. 
The following delegation was registered to speak:
Committee received the following written submissions, which are filed with the Clerk:
The committee recessed from 10:42 a.m. EST to 10:49 a.m. EST. 
Following the resumption of the meeting proceedings, Member B. Bourns tabled BHC motion No. 2025-23-02. 
Lesley Collins, Program Manager, Heritage Planning and Avery Marshall, Planner I were available to answer questions. Following questions and answers, the Committee adopted the report recommendations as amended by BHC motion No. 2025-23-02 and BHC motion No. 2025-23-01.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council issue a Notice of Intention to Designate 119 Osgoode Street under Part IV of theOntario Heritage Actaccording to the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value attached as Document 5.

WHEREAS Report Number ACS2025-PDB-RHU-0031 recommends the designation of 119 Osgoode Street according to the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value attached as Document 5: andWHEREAS the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value describes several exclusions that are not part of the designation;WHEREAS the owner and their representative, in a meeting with Heritage Planning staff on 4 June 2025 and through written comments provided on 6 June 2025, have expressed an interest in ensuring clarity on the excluded sections of the property.THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that Document 5 Statement of Cultural Heritage Value be replaced with the attached revised Statement of Cultural Heritage Value, amending the exclusion from “gymnasium in its entirety” to “rear wing built in the 1980s”.

That Document 5 be further amended to include the side yards in the designation with Document 5 amended on page 65 as follows to read: "The designation includes the 1897, 1908, and 1918 exterior sections of the building as well as the front and side yards of the 1897 section. "
